notes.title: Peaceful Lands is now RELEASED!
notes.content:
After 6 months of work, [b]Peaceful Lands is now released[/b]!

Thank you everyone for supporting and don't miss the special [u][b]20% discount[/b][/u] for the release.


As promised, [b]we're giving away a copy of Peaceful Lands[/b] to 1 person for the release of the game. You can participate in the giveaway by joining our Discord Server:

[url=https://discord.gg/GANt9ZG94V][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549363/ed08ddcbca6099cfb591b98d36332203a3394eea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Join our Q&A and Demo Playthrough With The Developer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

On [b]Thursday 22th June[/b], we will be broadcasting Peaceful Lands’s demo and answering questions from the community!

This will take place at [b]7AM PDT and 4PM CEST[/b] for one hour if you want to join and take part.

If you can’t make it to the Q&A you can also join our Discord to ask the dev any questions you may have:
[url=https://discord.gg/GANt9ZG94V][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549363/ed08ddcbca6099cfb591b98d36332203a3394eea.png[/img][/url]

Also don't forget to try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2407870/Peaceful_Lands_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13

notes.title: 🚀 Playtesters Call for "Peaceful Lands"
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that we're looking for playtesters for "Peaceful Lands". 🚀 This is a great opportunity to explore the game early and provide valuable feedback to help us improve. 🛠️

If you're interested, please join our Discord server for more information and to apply. 📝

As a token of our appreciation, one playtester will be randomly selected to receive a free copy of the game after the playtesting period. 🎁

Thank you for your support. We look forward to working with you to make "Peaceful Lands" the best game it can be! 🙌

[url=https://discord.com/invite/GANt9ZG94V][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549363/ed08ddcbca6099cfb591b98d36332203a3394eea.png[/img][/url]
